chunks: Sejumlah sahabat kami, dari Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, dari bapaknya, dari Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, dari orang yang meriwayatkannya, dari Abu Abdullah (alamah) yang berkata:
Bayang baru dilahirkan disembelih untuk (Aqeeqa) dan disunat pada hari ketujuh.
ai.seo_question: Apa saja ritual yang direkomendasikan untuk bayi baru lahir pada hari ketujuh menurut hadis Syiah?
ai.summary: Hadith from al-Kafi establishes the Sunnah of performing Aqeeqa and circumcision on the seventh day, a practice deeply rooted in the Prophet’s tradition and emphasized by Shia jurists as a means of spiritual and physical purification. The timing aligns with the Islamic custom of naming the child and offering gratitude for its birth, reflecting the holistic approach to a newborn's entry into the community. This narration underscores the continuity of prophetic rituals within Shia fiqh, linking bodily purity with religious obligation.
